passive.name: Invincible Rider
passive.text: The Shield value provided by the equipper increases by **30/38/46/52/60%**. When any squad member triggers **Interrupt** or **Perfect Dodge**, all squad members' DMG increases by **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** and Daze dealt increases by **12/15/18/21/24%** for 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Meridian Mapping
passive.text: The equipper's **EX Special Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG increases by **25/28.7/32.5/36.2/40%**. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains **2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2** Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

passive.name: Hot Spring Soup
passive.text: Reduces DMG taken by **7.5/8.5/9.5/10.5/12%**. When attacked, the equipper's Energy Generation Rate increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** for 12s. When the equipper switches off-field, this buff will be transferred to the new on-field character with its duration refreshed. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Standard Blocking Technique
passive.text: While Shielded, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.4/0.46/0.52/0.58/0.64**/s. The Anomaly Buildup of **EX Special Attacks**/**Assist Follow-Ups** increase by **36/40/45/50/55%**.

substatLine: ATK%/Flat ATK (until 3000 ATK) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > PEN
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Assist > Special Attack > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Unyielding Strikes
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive melee attacks, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge: Light as a Swallow
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Sizzling Oil Supreme
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward melee attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Moving Mountains and Seas
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Intimidating Presence
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of **Assist Points** when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Ride the Momentum
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Sonic Pressure-Point Strike
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Touch of Death
entries.text:
With **Break Force**, press Special Attackto activate:
**Special Attack: Touch of Death** attacks centered on the enemy, dealing **Physical DMG**.
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of **Special Attack: Touch of Death** consumes 1 point of Break Force.
When Pan Yinhu is the active character, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 40% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active character, he becomes Invulnerable.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
**EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike** unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Gain 3 points of **Break Force** on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the **Quick Assist** of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch **Special Attack: Touch of Death** until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive **Physical DMG** to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive **Physical DMG** and healing all squad members for **820** HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering **1.4**% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment
entries.text: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's **EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike** hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the **Meridian Flow** effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to **18%** of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Iron Stomach
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Rupture** character or shares the same Faction:
When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with **Special Attack: Touch of Death**, the enemy suffers the **Depleted Qi** effect, increasing DMG from all units against the target by 20%. Each hit of **Special Attack: Touch of Death** inflicts a 10s **Depleted Qi** effect. This effect does not stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

entries.name: Qi Shield
entries.text: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by **Depleted Qi**.

entries.name: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
entries.text: For every 6 points of **Break Force** consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the **Depleted Qi** effect applied when **Special Attack: Touch of Death** hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.

entries.name: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: First-Class Head Chef
entries.text: When **Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!** heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating **Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!**, gain the **Backup Provisions** effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the **Backup Provisions** effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with **Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!**'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.

entries.name: "Thiren"
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Meridian Theory
entries.text: The **Meridian Flow** effect provided by **Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment** increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
